name: RAEN MCP Gateway
description: RAEN's paid x402 services on Base Mainnet, served over one gateway. Five tools (law lookup, ticker analysis, dispute letter, image generation, contract analysis); every call settles in USDC via the x402 protocol. First call per wallet is free (charge-and-rebate, net $0).

bearer.description: Gateway key: send Authorization: Bearer <key>. Free 30-day dev key via POST /keys/request {"email":"you@example.com"} or clear https://raen-x402-quest.vercel.app

skills.name: Law Lookup
skills.description: Look up US consumer-protection law citations (FCRA, FDCPA, TILA, state UDAP) on a topic. Returns formal citations, plain-English summaries, reporting timelines, and statutes of limitations. Information only, not legal advice. Price: $0.05 USDC per call (x402, Base).

skills.name: Ticker Analysis
skills.description: Request a synthetic ticker market-consensus demo (TradingAgents payload). No live market data; not financial advice. Price: $0.05 USDC per call (x402, Base).

skills.name: Dispute Letter
skills.description: Generate an FCRA-compliant credit dispute letter plus an SVG certificate of dispute (Dispute-Forge). Price: $0.75 USDC per call (x402, Base).

skills.name: Image Generation
skills.description: Generate an AI image from a text prompt (Gemini upstream). Returns base64 PNG metadata/JSON. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402, Base).

skills.name: Contract Analysis
skills.description: Analyze contract text for risky, one-sided, or unusual clauses. Returns a risk score, flagged clauses with severity/explanation/suggested edits (Contract-Eye). Price: $0.05 USDC per call (x402, Base).
